summary_1line: After Bhishma’s fall, Karna enters the battlefield, mourns him, and vows to defend the Kaurava army and confront the Pandavas.

image_candidates.scene_text: Karna arrives on the battlefield with tear-filled eyes as the Kaurava warriors mourn the fallen Bhishma lying like a fallen sun upon the ground.
Karna stands before the grieving Kaurava host, raising his bow and declaring that he will bear the burden of protecting the army.
The vast battlefield surrounds Bhishma resting on the ground while soldiers wail and Karna approaches like a determined guardian.
